items.statement: Oxidative addition is likely turnover-limiting within the modeled pathway.
items.expected: The α/β oxidative-addition transition states are slightly higher in free energy than the corresponding reductive-elimination transition states, supporting C–H cleavage as likely turnover-limiting.

items.statement: The computed profile is consistent with α-selective product formation but does not assign it from the tiny oxidative-addition difference alone.
items.expected: The α reductive-elimination transition state is lower than β, consistent with α preference; the paper cautions that the small α/β oxidative-addition ΔΔG cannot be quantitatively resolved by DFT.
